items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was conducting. He was playing bass on the records that – with Dizzy he was playing bass, but on . . . Paul West, you mean? Yeah, but on that he was conducting.

ctx.x: Yeah, Montreal. I wrote it here in L.A., and I did some things outside of New York. I can’t think, but the record was done in Montreal and they were all Montreal strings, but Randy and bass and drums are from New York. Paul . . .
